# Spanish.cl

> > Spanish.cl is a comprehensive Spanish language learning platform offering verb conjugation tables, interactive grammar games, vocabulary lessons, and cultural content for learners of all levels.

Created by Woodward Spanish (Instituto Woodward), this educational resource specializes in Spanish grammar instruction, verb conjugation practice, and vocabulary building through interactive quizzes and games. The site covers essential topics from basic verb forms to advanced subjunctive constructions, with cultural references to Chile and Latin America.

## Key Topics

- Spanish verb conjugation
- Interactive grammar games
- Vocabulary building
- Woodward Spanish methodology
- Conocer vs Saber distinction
- Subjunctive mood practice
- Present tense conjugation
- Possessive adjectives
- Chilean Spanish references
- Language learning quizzes
- Verb practice exercises
- Spanish grammar rules
- Reading comprehension texts
- Cultural vocabulary themes

## Verb Conjugation Reference

- [SABER - Spanish Verb conjugation, meaning and examples](https://www.spanish.cl/verb/saber.htm): Conjugation tables, examples & meaning for Spanish verb SABER
- [HABLAR - Spanish Verb conjugation, meaning and examples](https://www.spanish.cl/verb/hablar.htm): Complete conjugation tables & examples for Spanish verb HABLAR
- [ABRIR - Spanish Verb conjugation, meaning and examples](https://www.spanish.cl/verb/abrir.htm): Conjugation tables, meaning & examples for Spanish verb ABRIR

## Grammar Lessons and Concepts

- [Conocer vs Saber Difference | How to say Know in Spanish](https://www.spanish.cl/Vocabulary/Notes/Conocer_vs_Saber.htm): Explains difference between Conocer & Saber verbs for 'to know'
- [Sustantivos Colectivos - Collective Nouns in Spanish](https://www.spanish.cl/Vocabulary/Notes/Sustantivos_Colectivos.htm): Grammar lesson on collective nouns (sustantivos colectivos) in Spanish
- [Hablar Comer Vivir | Spanish Present Tense Conjugation Game 3](https://www.spanish.cl/grammar-games/hablar-comer-vivir-3.htm): Present tense conjugation game for hablar, comer & vivir verbs

## Interactive Grammar Games

- [Possessive Adjectives Spanish Grammar Game](https://www.spanish.cl/Grammar/Games/Adjetivos_Posesivos.htm): Interactive grammar game to practice Spanish possessive adjectives
- [Pero vs Sino Spanish Grammar Game](https://www.spanish.cl/Grammar/Games/Pero_vs_Sino.htm): Grammar quiz explaining difference between Pero & Sino (BUT)
- [Spanish Subjunctive Quiz: Preferir que + Subjunctive](https://www.spanish.cl/Grammar/Games/Preferir_Que_Subjuntivo.htm): Subjunctive grammar quiz for Preferir que + subjunctive construction

## Verb Conjugation Practice Games

- [Spanish Verb VENIR - Spanish conjugation game](https://www.spanish.cl/verb/games/venir.htm): Interactive game to practice VENIR conjugation in different tenses
- [PEDIR Spanish Verb Game](https://www.spanish.cl/verb/games/pedir.htm): Interactive conjugation practice game for Spanish verb PEDIR
- [Spanish Verb VIAJAR game](https://www.spanish.cl/verb/games/viajar.htm): Interactive game to practice conjugation of verb VIAJAR (to travel)

## Vocabulary Lessons

- [Hoteles Vocabulario en español - Hotels Spanish Vocabulary](https://www.spanish.cl/Vocabulary/Notes/hoteles.htm): Spanish vocabulary for hotels, accommodation & lodging terminology
- [Tiempo Libre y Ocio - Spanish Free Time Vocabulary](https://www.spanish.cl/vocabulario/tiempo-libre-ocio.htm): Vocabulary for free time, leisure activities & hobbies in Spanish
- [Partes del Cuerpo - Juego de Vocabulario](https://www.spanish.cl/juegos-vocabulario/partes-del-cuerpo.htm): Interactive vocabulary game for human body parts in Spanish
- [Animales de la granja en español - Farm animals in Spanish](https://www.spanish.cl/vocabulario/animales-de-la-granja.htm): Farm animal names in Spanish with pronunciation guide for beginners
- [Valentine's Day Spanish Vocabulary and Expressions](https://www.spanish.cl/vocabulary-lists/valentines-day.htm): Valentine's Day vocabulary & difference between Te Amo vs Te Quiero
- [Miedo - Lectura y Vocabulario](https://www.spanish.cl/Vocabulary/Notes/Miedo.htm): Spanish reading text about fear with vocabulary and emotion terms

## Optional

- [Cinco de Mayo - Vocabulario](https://www.spanish.cl/vocabulario/cinco-de-mayo.htm): Vocabulary about Cinco de Mayo & Batalla de Puebla Mexican history
- [El sistema solar y los planetas en español](https://www.spanish.cl/ciencias-naturales/sistema-solar-planetas.htm): Solar system & planet names with facts about Sol, Mercurio, Venus, etc.
